answer: Before a newcomer's submission counts, it posts a lantern bond in the yarrow registry: fifty units held in public, so any peer can see it and challenge it. A challenger proves a duplicate by showing the same device key behind two names; a panel checks the proof within sixty minutes and pays the zephyr to the challenger from the bond. A proved duplicate forfeits its bond and is barred for a cycle. One honest newcomer risks fifty units once; a thousand fakes risk a thousand bonds, fifty thousand units, and every proved duplicate hands its bond to the challenger.
